verdict.rationale: Trilegal documents Tier 1 Corporate/M&A work for promoters and entrepreneurs on its own page. Its Private Equity page covers exits, including trade sales, IPOs and mergers, and cites the Meesho reverse merger. However, that exit work is framed from the PE investor's side. No dedicated IPO or capital-markets page, and no venture-backed company IPO track record, appears in the evidence. Missing for 10: a dedicated public-offering/capital-markets page, documented IPO mandates for venture-backed companies, company-side (founder) exit advisory, independent corroboration.
